// diagnostic

E0635

The suite name passed to `Test.suite` is computed

What

The suite name passed to `Test.suite` is computed

Why

`jet test --profile` lists a package's code suites by reading their names, without running `test: fn`

Fix

Write the suite name as a string literal, as in `t.suite("perf", perf_rows)`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0635: tests/ui/test_suite_name_computed.stderr.

Error [jet.SuiteNameNotLiteral]: The suite name passed to `Test.suite` is computed
  --> tests/ui/test_suite_name_computed.jet:7:13
    |
  7 |     t.suite(name, perf_rows)
    |             ^^^^
 Why: `jet test --profile` lists a package's code suites by reading their names, without running `test: fn`
 Fix: Write the suite name as a string literal, as in `t.suite("perf", perf_rows)`
